{
  "headline": "VISTA-16 phase 3 trial of varespladib stopped early for futility; human genetics show PLA2G2A has no causal role in coronary disease (association score 0.0), making target_not_causal the primary failure mode.",
  "summary": "The VISTA-16 trial randomized 5,189–6,500 acute coronary syndrome patients with metabolic risk factors (triglycerides ≥150 mg/dL, glucose ≥110 mg/dL, blood pressure ≥130/85 mmHg) within 96 hours of onset. The independent DSMB recommended stopping the study on 9 March 2012 due to lack of efficacy, and enrollment was closed with patients removed from therapy. Human genetic evidence gives PLA2G2A a coronary artery disorder association score of 0.0 with zero evidence items, indicating no causal link, and the intended biomarker sPLA2-IIA mass is classified as non-causal. The phase 2 FRANCIS-ACS trial had already shown varespladib reduced LDL-C and inflammatory biomarkers by ~84–87% but produced no difference in clinical cardiovascular events. The calculator predicts expected HR = 1.0 (causal RRR = 0%) because target genetics are not_causal. Confidence in the target_not_causal conclusion is high.",
  "key_evidence": [
    "Genetic association score for PLA2G2A with coronary artery disorder: 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G2A)",
    "Patients randomized: 5,189 participants (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01130246 VISTA-16) / 6,500 patients (Varespladib source)",
    "DSMB recommended stopping VISTA-16 for 'lack of efficacy' on 9 March 2012 (Anthera Halts VISTA-16 Clinical Study Due to Lack of Efficacy Following Recommendation by the Independent Data Safety Monitoring Board)",
    "Phase 2 FRANCIS-ACS: varespladib reduced biomarkers ~84–87% but showed no treatment differences in clinical cardiovascular events (Effects of varespladib methyl on biomarkers and major cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome patients)",
    "Calculator expected HR = 1.0, causal RRR = 0% because target genetics are not_causal"
  ],
  "what_would_change_this": "Only evidence of a causal role for PLA2G2A in coronary disease (e.g., Mendelian randomization showing protective effect of loss-of-function variants) would alter the conclusion; the genetic score of 0.0 and futility stop are already definitive.",
  "readthrough_note": "No read-through hypotheses were generated; other sPLA2-IIA inhibitor programmes would face the same genetic evidence against target causality."
}
